title: Immobile neighbour, water at the step

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: I am next door. The person here cannot get out of bed.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Is there a medical device, or an injury you can see?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: No injury I should describe. They are immobile. Water is at the step.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Yes. Elderly, and they cannot stand.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Rong Kwang District, Phrae. The house with the invented yellow gate.
